{{Quote|Did Senator Palpatine arrive with you?''"<br />"''He had some lingering business to attend to on Coruscant. But I'm certain that the Naboo delegation will arrive in time for the summit's opening remarks.|[[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] and Finis Valorum|<ref name="CoD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>}}
'''Naboo Senatorial Delegation''' was the [[Politics/Legends|political]] body that represented the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and the 35 other worlds of the backwater [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]] during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It consisted of a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] and their entourage. One of its historical leaders, [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], went on to become [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the Republic. After Palpatine [[Declaration of a New Order|transformed]] the Republic into a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and anointed himself [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]], the Naboo Senatorial Delegation stayed in place as part of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]]. It was disbanded along with all other delegations when the Emperor decided to [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|shut down]] the assembly in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].

==Organization==
{{Quote|The chair recognizes the senator from the sovereign system of Naboo.|Finis Valorum|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace'' (novel)]]</ref>}}
[[File:Padme_Military_Act.png|thumb|left|200px|Senator Amidala and her entourage]]
The Naboo Senatorial Delegation occupied a seat in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], the highest deliberative and legislative council of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It not only represented the provincial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], as its name implied, but all 36 worlds of the backwater [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]]. The delegation consisted of a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] and their entourage, which included all manners of [[Senatorial aide|aides]] and [[Advisor/Legends|advisors]].<ref name="SoN">''[[Secrets of Naboo]]''</ref> Usually, the current senator was to be succeeded by their preferred aide,<ref name="DP" /> but the candidate still had to run for the office<ref name="SW:AotCJN">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (junior novelization)|''Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones'' (junior novelization)]]</ref> and be elected.<ref name="FF61">[[The Official Star Wars Fact File 61|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' 61]]</ref> Also, the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Monarch of Naboo]] had input on the nomination of candidates for the post.<ref name="SW:AotCN" /> It should be noted, however, that the head of the Senatorial Delegation did not necessarily originate from Naboo, and could hail from another planet of the Chommell sector.<ref name="Greejatus homeworld">According to his entry on the defunct [[Databank (original)|Databank]] of [[StarWars.com]], [[Janus Greejatus/Legends|Janus Greejatus]] hailed from [[Chommell Minor/Legends|Chommell Minor]].</ref>

On [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the Republic<ref name="DP" /> and purported fountainhead of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] race,<ref name="EGtP&M">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> the Delegation occupied the [[Naboo Embassy]], a richly decorated monad located below and to the west of [[Monument Plaza/Legends|Monument Plaza]] and the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Tower]].<ref name="DP" /> Like most other politicians, the senators of the Naboo Delegation would assert their sectorial authority through elaborate [[Clothing/Legends|garments]], usually tailored in a typical Nabooian style.<ref name="SW:E1TVD">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> In addition to their impeccable garbs, Naboo statesmen also used to wear their [[Hair/Legends|hair]] long by tradition,<ref name="DP" /> although not all of them did.<ref name="Hair">Neither [[Vidar Kim]] or [[Horace Vancil/Legends|Horace Vancil]] had long [[Hair/Legends|hair]].[[The Official Star Wars Fact File 61|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' 61]]</ref>

Originally composed exclusively of Humans, the Naboo Senatorial Delegation had long expressed biased views about the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibians]] native to Naboo. However, xenoethnographers insisted that the Gungans were not "simple-minded barbarians who have barely mastered the [[Technology level|basic hallmarks]] of civilization," as the Delegation asserted.<ref name="SoN" /> This changed following the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], which led to the formation of an alliance between the Nabooian Humans and the Gungans.<ref name="SW:TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> Following those events, the Gungan [[Bombad General/Legends|Bombad General]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] became part of the Naboo Senatorial Delegation.<ref name="SW:AotC">{{Film|II}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:JarJarDestroysTheRepublic-AotC.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Representative Binks in the Senate]]
At the beginning of the first [[Standard century/Legends|century]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Unidentified Naboo senator|senator]] was at the head of the Delegation, with a young [[Vidar Kim]] serving as her [[Senatorial aide|aide]]. By [[54 BBY/Legends|54 BBY]], Kim himself had risen up in the ranks and become senator, a role he retained until his [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] two years after. From [[52 BBY/Legends|52]] to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the Naboo Senatorial Delegation was led by [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]],<ref name="DP" /> with [[Ars Dangor/Legends|Ars Dangor]],<ref name="DSTC">''[[Death Star Technical Companion]]''</ref> [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]], [[Kinman Doriana/Legends|Kinman Doriana]] acting as his aides.<ref name="CoD" /> Additionally, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jorus C'baoth]] served as Palpatine's [[Jedi Ambassador|Jedi Advisor]].<ref name="RPGRCR">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook]]''</ref> When Palpatine [[Supreme Chancellor election, 32 BBY/Legends|succeeded]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the Republic in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], he was replaced by [[Janus Greejatus/Legends|Janus Greejatus]] of [[Chommell Minor/Legends|Chommell Minor]], who proved unpopular. After two years of service, Greejatus was traded in favor of the Nabooian [[Horace Vancil/Legends|Horace Vancil]].<ref name="Greejatus DB" /> Six years after his election, Senator Vancil was succeeded by [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], former [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen of Naboo]] and architect of reconciliation on the planet,<ref name="SW:AotCN" /> with the Gungan Jar Jar Binks as [[Junior Representative/Legends|Associate Planetary Representative]].<ref name="SW:AotC" /> Amidala remained at the head of the Naboo Senatorial Delegation until her [[Death/Legends|death]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], killed by her [[Marriage/Legends|husband]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="SW:RotS" /> Following Amidala's passing and the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Representative Binks took the mantle of senator in the reformed [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]], and he was himself succeeded by [[Pooja Naberrie/Legends|Pooja Naberrie]], niece of the late Amidala.<ref name="CSWE:Naberrie" /> With the [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|disbanding]] of the Senate in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the maintain of the Naboo Senatorial Delegation was no longer be necessary.<ref name="SW:ANH" /> Pooja Naberrie, however, remained the gray eminence of Naboo politics.<ref name="SWG:TCG:POGG">[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>
